description: B1 (the milestone A gate's row: the plate switch had no on-screen hint): the first time the giant locks a plated titan - the lock frames one of his plates, and the lock-switch picks the next in reach. Done once the giant switches plates (or after 25 s).
text: Locked on a titan: the lock frames one of his stone plates. {target_next} (or a flick of the right stick) picks the next plate in reach - break the ones you can reach.
